resources.string: Double-tap empty space on Home or Lock Screen to turn screen off

Pixel Double Tap uses Android's Accessibility lock action (GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN) solely to turn your Pixel 11 Pro screen off when you double-tap empty wallpaper space on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, while keeping Ultrasonic Fingerprint and Face Unlock working.

Privacy guarantee:
• Zero Internet permission (100% offline)
• Checks only whether the Home Screen, Lock Screen, or keyboard is active (never reads or stores text, messages, or passwords)
• Touch watcher is completely detached while inside apps or when the keyboard is open.
